competing_trace_defects.description: The step-19 click opens a screen titled “New post” with an @gourmet mention, rather than the target toot's reply interface.

chains.rationale: At reuse target step 20, the agent explicitly treats the “New post” composer as a reply interface and enters the requested text there. summary: The reused false reply-interface premise was carried through typing and submission in a standalone New post composer; no visible correction returned the agent to the target toot.
